name: Ratnagiri
registryBasis: The official Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh Ratnagiri district page identifies the district land-record custodian, says city-survey records maintain property cards and maps, and lists Ratnagiri city survey office (CTSO) records. This evidences a local cadastral custodian and map service, but not a live parcel feature response.

queries.query: Ratnagiri Maharashtra official cadastral parcel map land records Mahabhulekh Bhu Naksha
queries.result: Found official Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh services, the official Ratnagiri district land-record page, Mahabhumi land-record portal, and the official Bhu-Naksha viewer. No safe anonymous Ratnagiri parcel feature response or native parcel identity was obtained.

queries.result: Official Marathi results confirmed Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh services, Mahabhu-Nakasha maps with land records, and the Ratnagiri district page's city-survey map/property-card custody. No public safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

source.name: Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh / Mahabhu-Nakasha

source.scope: Ratnagiri city-survey and Maharashtra official land-record/cadastral-map services; citywide vector coverage was not verified.

The Mahabhumi dashboard route returned 404 in the shell request. No citywide completeness claim is made.
